name: simple-restaurant-pos
description: Point-of-sale for one restaurant. Cloudflare Workers + D1 + Upstash, Solid on Pages, and a printer agent on the LAN.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pos/shared && npm run typecheck -w @pos/web && npm run typecheck -w @pos/agent
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check -w @pos/api
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:api
